extracted.title: Railways announce infrastructure works at five stations near the Mela area
extracted.summary: The Ministry of Railways has announced passenger-amenity and capacity works at Nashik Road, Devlali, Odha, Kherwadi and Kasbe Sukene stations ahead of the Simhastha, including works at Nashik Road such as platform extension and a wider foot overbridge. This describes planned works, not train timings.

excerpt: Official PIB release located by search; page text not read. The release is also the source of the 'over 3 crore pilgrims' railway planning figure.
